modules.mfa.text.559bfe6ea81d: TextGrid first uses a separate transcript interval tier. With a single words tier, word labels are concatenated in order and aligned anew; existing boundaries do not constrain alignment. The phones tier is not used as a transcript. Originals are retained. Acoustic models and dictionaries must share a phone inventory. Character dictionaries need characters; pinyin dictionaries need their specified pinyin and tone format. On desktop, import through the model and dictionary menus; checked combinations are applied and remembered. Pending resources pause submission; cancelling restores the applied combination. Self-tests support dictionary entries a, 啊 and a1. Web uses administrator-registered models; an imported dictionary affects only this task. Out-of-vocabulary words are reported before feature extraction.
modules.mfa.text.e2492d1390d0: New drafts default to Beam 100 and Retry beam 400; saved values are retained. Increasing Beam broadens the search and may take longer. Changing Beam raises Retry beam to at least four times Beam; on submission, Retry beam at or below Beam is reset to four times Beam.
modules.mfa.text.a866cccc7e90: The current MFA 3.3.8 component uses the CPU regardless of installed graphics hardware. First install components from the official site, import the component ZIP obtained from a cloud drive, or choose an extracted component folder. Verification is automatic. A matching Mandarin model and dictionary are included. Other existing environments can be selected under Advanced. Installed local alignment needs no public internet access.
modules.mfa.text.72fe08c72fdc: Logs show redacted stages only. After cancellation, timeout or failure, partial output and diagnostics remain in the separate local task folder and are not complete results. Web data follows account policies; unverified nodes and server capabilities remain pending.
